findings.claim: Q2 2026 revenue rose 13.8% to $15.1M and net income rose 19.9% to $1.9M, but diluted EPS fell 18.9% to $0.43 (from $0.53) due to more shares outstanding after the April 2026 rights offering. Adjusted EBITDA was $3.4M vs $2.4M.
findings.source_title: M-tron Industries, Inc. Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results

findings.claim: Backlog increased 37.2% to $84.0M as of June 30, 2026, from $61.2M a year earlier; Q1 2026 backlog was $76.8M.
findings.source_title: M-tron Industries, Inc. Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results

findings.claim: M-tron completed a rights offering on April 27, 2026 that raised approximately $42.1M and issued 713,362 shares, bringing shares outstanding to about 4.3M.
findings.source_title: M-tron Industries, Inc. Announces Completion of Rights Offering

findings.claim: In January 2026, holders exercised the warrants distributed as a dividend in April 2025: 470,205 shares were issued under basic subscription plus 112,028 shares via over-subscription, for approximately $27.7M in gross proceeds.
findings.source_title: M-tron Industries 2025 Annual Report to Stockholders

findings.claim: Cash and equivalents were $96.2M at June 30, 2026, with no borrowings under its $20.0M credit facilities.
findings.source_title: MPTI 10-Q Filings - M-tron Industries, Inc. SEC 10-Q

findings.claim: On June 9, 2026, M-tron received a $6.8M follow-on production order from a U.S. DoD contractor for several C-UAS (counter-drone) radar programs, mainly oven-controlled crystal oscillators, with work in Orlando through 2027.
findings.source_title: M-tron Industries, Inc. Awarded $6.8 Million Production Contract for Major Counter Drone Radar Programs

findings.claim: On June 30, 2026, M-tron received $4M in production orders for a next-generation electronic warfare system (high-power spectrum control solutions), with work in Orlando through 2027.
findings.source_title: M-tron Industries, Inc. Awarded $4 Million in Production Contracts for Advanced Electronic Warfare System

findings.claim: M-tron previously won a $2.7M counter-drone radar order (April 2026), a $20M two-year U.S. air defense program contract (December 2025) and a $5.5M naval weapon system contract (September 2025).
findings.source_title: M-tron Secures $2.7M Order for Counter-Drone Radar Technologies

findings.claim: Management said defense primes signed seven-year framework agreements for missile systems and that it expects first purchase orders under the resulting increased volumes around Q1 2027, for 2028 production.
findings.source_title: M-Tron Industries Reports Q2 2026 Results: Full Earnings Call Transcript

findings.claim: Management said backlog for the next two quarters exceeds what it is currently producing and that it is focused on increasing manufacturing capacity; it is running a full first shift and only a skeleton second shift.
findings.source_title: M-Tron Industries Reports Q2 2026 Results: Full Earnings Call Transcript

findings.claim: The CEO guided second-half 2026 gross margin to roughly 41.5%–43.5% (possibly 44%), citing ramp-up of new programs and continuing tariffs.
findings.source_title: M-Tron Industries Reports Q2 2026 Results: Full Earnings Call Transcript

findings.claim: Revenue and receivables remain concentrated in a small number of customers, according to the 10-Q summary.
findings.source_title: MPTI 10-Q Filings - M-tron Industries, Inc. SEC 10-Q

findings.claim: Q2 2026 EPS of $0.43 missed the $0.53 consensus; Q3 2026 consensus is about $0.585 EPS on $15.3M revenue.
findings.source_title: M-tron Industries Q3 2026 Earnings Date & Estimates | MarketBeat

findings.claim: With about $96M in cash against a company producing roughly $15M of quarterly revenue, the rights offering and warrant capital appear sized for acquisitions; deal timing and accretion are the main swing factors for per-share value.
findings.source_title: M-tron Industries, Inc. Announces Subscription Rights Offering To Address Rapid Changes in US Defense Sector
